title: Importing a Joomla site whose host takes 2 MB per upload installs Claude Cowork: the upload road carries the release package without the quickstart contracts (436 KB, not 63 MB)
expect: S1: every test passes; a release-shaped package over a 2 MB upload limit is installed over the upload road, the file sent is under 2 MB and holds no administrator/lib/contracts/ entry, the engine and the receiver-wide JSON are kept
fence: An import never sends a customer's Joomla site the quickstart contracts it does not read, and never changes another byte of the release package
